complete_four_business.application_to_boss_immune: 命中关联应携带本次权威原因/令牌，防止无敌、无效目标或别的失败误取消箭矢后续；收到通用false无法决定反馈类别。

complete_four_business.full_chain_observation: BITING_FOCUS→MagicFocus/ModSpells.BITING FangSpell，原生DarkWand.finishUsingItem→MagicResults服务端SpellResult，正确ILL staff进入WandUtil图案/环形MasterFang生产，createMasterFang落地检查后入world。Fangs.native tick虚调用Master.fangTick：warmup<0发送entity event4并放大碰撞尺寸，<=-19发送一次event5闭合声；恰-21才在方块位置inflate1.4查询活体结算，<-33 discard。每实体damage producer明确拒owner、非目标Enemy、trueOwner盟友、双向盟友及isInvulnerable；实际hurt成功才强制iframe11和knockback，Player来源成功才火/灵魂收益。
complete_four_business.concrete_observation: 计1：真实魔法攻击预告/闭合声音先于最终目标资格与hurt成功，后置控制/收益只在成功后结算；整条Master/base家族合并，不将图案、base/子类、event4/5另加数。Fangs.handleEntityEvent虚调用Master.toClientHandle，4开attackAnimationState/本地spawn声，5仅本地snap声，均无目标ID/拒绝原因；即使空挥、盟友/无敌目标被过滤仍可发。warmup精确相等-21，重载存档只保存warmup等，sentSpike/sentSnap未存，重载可重播预告；读取<-21的warmup不会补一次伤害。基类普通fang的totem分支忽略hurt结果却加火，Master路径不走该分支；不能用父类注释代替实际虚调用。
complete_four_business.application_to_boss_immune: Boss免疫文字/微光/嗡声应在服务端明确拒控后发，不能直接复用攻击的spawn/snap事件。受控目标、成功追加击退、普通播放声须分开；新发回执需按目标身份与实际拒绝节流，不能因动画事件已发而判已显示拒绝。
complete_four_business.limitations: Master/Fangs/FangSpell全文、真实focus和原生finish/MagicResults、Wand图案与createMasterFang完整方法、最终盟友谓词、renderer全文已读。平台EntityEvent包实现/原版声音路由未审；SEHelper的EntityFinder/能力内部作为已调用外部支持未全审，不声称跨维度盟友行为。renderer调用模型setupAnim未展开骨骼，不能证明身体动作/深度/实际PNG。无游戏、资产或正式修改。

isHarderThan compares effectiveDifficulty strictly greater than Difficulty.NORMAL.ordinal(); it is not a simple global difficulty==HARD predicate. Formula includes world/chunk time and moon contribution. Full Level.getCurrentDifficultyAt supplier/math helpers remain unexpanded; no live difficulty eligibility claim.

start first sets adjusted warmup, spellCastingTickCount, absolute nextAttackTickCount, prepare-sound request and synchronized spell ID. Only after that super.start returns does blindness read getTarget again and store its numeric ID. The ID is an attempt-start stamp, not an effect-success receipt; callback exceptions and arbitrary reentrancy are not modeled.

lastTargetId is one mutable numeric-ID slot on this goal, not a set of all historical victims, UUID, per-world ledger, expiring victim lease or one-success-per-target guarantee. A later different start overwrites it. Source-level A-start/B-start/A eligibility may differ from a permanent seen set, but no live sequence or ID-reuse exploit is asserted.

Continuation checks current target nonnull/alive and warmup>0, without equality to stamped start ID. When delivered tick decrements warmup exactly to0, blindness re-reads current getTarget and requests BLINDNESS400 attributed to caster. It does not request the original stamped object or UUID. Entry local-difficulty/last-ID conditions are not repeated by this continuation or spell body.

UseSpellGoal has no own stop, flags or everytick override. Base stop is no-op and everytick false; selector cleanup invokes continuation then wrapper stop, full passes update/start and tick running true, alternating Mob phases use running-only false. adjustedTickDelay20 becomes10 callback ticks. This does not establish10 world ticks, exact walltime, natural scheduler bypass or complete NoAI/removal behavior.

Loss/death of current target can stop the use goal at selector cleanup before warmup completion. There is no own use-goal rollback of lastTargetId, nextAttackTickCount or spellCastingTickCount. A same-ID target can remain locally excluded on later admission until overwritten/recreated, irrespective of whether prior effect happened. Exact runtime interruption timing and external writers remain boundaries.

addEffect asks canBeAffected first; Applicable event ALLOW/DENY can override default, then the default undead branch rejects regeneration/poison. Added event occurs after admission gate and before insert/update; it is not cancelable/result-bearing here. Returning false can reflect applicability denial or lack of reported change, not a uniquely identified Boss-immunity reason.

Existing effect update may replace duration/amplifier/ambient/visible/icon or manage hidden effects. The caller Boolean is about this local add/update path and cannot be treated as visible blindness or a universal no-side-effects-on-false guarantee. Full ticking/attribute/client darkness/fog and custom effect overrides are unexpanded.

Blindness ignores addEffect Boolean. After normal return performSpellCasting, the base goal requests casting sound even if addEffect returned false. No refund of the start stamp or next-attack clock, no target/reason-bearing refusal text and no actual damage/payment/native acquisition receipt are produced by this chain.

Server casting/busy uses spellCastingTickCount>0 while client uses synchronized positive spell ID. customServerAiStep decrements positive count after Mob goal step. Separate casting-hold goal owns MOVE+LOOK, stops navigation on start, looks at current target, and clears spell ID on stop. Clearing ID does not itself clear busy count, attack warmup or start stamp; no synchronized end-to-end timing guarantee.

Client spell particles and arm pose consume casting state/spell color; this own cue is caster state rather than accepted victim effect or denial. Particle/sound/network/render backend and actual visible/audible result not verified. No new visual asset was made.

Mirror uses the same shared spell-start/hold framework but own canUse rejects already-invisible source; it requests self INVISIBILITY1200 ignoring Boolean, with castingTime20 and interval340 versus blindness180. Mirror is adjacent support0, not a second species/spell/timer reference. Both use goals have empty own flags; shared server casting state, not an invented direct flag conflict, gates admission.

This presentation reads invisibility/local state, not the blindness target ID or applicability return. No independent illusion/render mechanism credit proposed.
